God of War Ragnarök — PS5 Buying Guide

PlayStation 5 · Updated 2026-08-05

God of War Ragnarök closes the Norse saga for Kratos and Atreus, delivering a bigger, more varied action-adventure than its 2018 predecessor and a perennial best-seller on PS5.

Editions explained

  • Standard — the full campaign
  • Digital Deluxe — adds behind-the-scenes video and cosmetic sets; skip unless you want the extras
  • Collector's Edition — physical statue and trinkets for collectors only

Digital vs physical on PS5

Ragnarök is a game you'll keep installed for a long time, so digital is convenient. It dips during major PlayStation sales, and PSN digital codes on key stores like Green Man Gaming frequently undercut the PlayStation Store. Compare before buying.
